title: Building the 5 times table with arrays
examples: How do I learn the 5 times table?
Why do the 5s end in 5 or 0?

explain.say: Hold up one hand. That is 5 fingers! The 5 times table is just hands of five. Look at the board: 4 rows of 5 dots, like 4 hands. That makes 20.

draw.text: Building the 5 times table with arrays

explain.say: Let us build it from the start. Here is 1 row of 5, so 1 times 5 is 5. One hand, five fingers. Each new row will add another 5. What will 2 rows make?
2 rows of 5 make 10, so 2 times 5 is 10. See the dots grow by one whole row each time? That is skip counting in 5s. What comes next?
3 rows make 15. Look at the answers so far: 5, 10, 15, 20. They always end in 5 or 0! Will 7 times 5 end in 5 or 0, do you think?
Superstar! Here are 10 rows of 5, which is 50. A wow trick: 5 times a number is half of 10 times it. So 8 times 5 is half of 80, which is 40. Try 6 times 5!

faq.q: How do I learn the 5 times table?
faq.a: Count in 5s: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25. Each step is one more row of 5 in the array. Your hands help, because each hand is 5.
asks: What is the easiest way to learn the 5s?

faq.q: Why do the 5s end in 5 or 0?
faq.a: Two fives make 10, so every second answer is a whole number of tens and ends in 0. The answers in between end in 5.
asks: Why does the 5 times table end in 0 and 5?

faq.a: 7 times 5 is 35. Count 7 hops of 5: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35. Or take half of 70.

faq.q: What is the half of ten trick?
faq.a: Five is half of ten, so 5 times a number is half of 10 times it. 8 times 10 is 80, and half of 80 is 40, so 8 times 5 is 40.
asks: How can tens help with fives?

faq.q: Where do we see fives in real life?
faq.a: Fingers on a hand, toes on a foot, and the minutes on a clock face, which go up by 5 from one number to the next.
asks: Where is the 5 times table used?

facts: Every answer in the 5 times table ends in 0 or 5.
On a clock face, each number is 5 minutes after the one before, so the 3 means 15 minutes past.

quiz.say: Which number is in the 5 times table?
quiz.show: Which number is in the 5 times table?

wrong.0: 52 ends in 2, so it is not in the 5 times table.
wrong.2: 23 ends in 3, so it is not in the 5 times table.
